lines.text: God tells Moses to take a young bull and two rams without blemish, plus unleavened bread in a basket.
Moses is to wash Aaron and his sons with water, then clothe Aaron and anoint him by pouring oil on his head.
Moses is to slaughter the bull at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn its flesh inside the camp as a sin offering.
God commands two lambs a year old each day, one offered in the morning and the other at midnight.
God says He will meet Israel at the tent, consecrate it by His glory, and dwell among them.
